cell_id_local.name: cell_id_local
cell_id_local.description: the cell's column in the custodian file

ageing_hours.name: ageing_hours
ageing_hours.description: operating hours at the checkpoint, the custodian's file-name label

checkpoint_kind.name: checkpoint_kind
checkpoint_kind.description: ageing, or recovery_event for a file the custodian names _afterAirAirStart (the curve after a passive air/air start-up)

hold_index.name: hold_index
hold_index.description: the order of the hold within the custodian file; a set point can be visited more than once, so (cell_id, source_file, hold_index) is the row key

set_point_A.name: set_point_A
set_point_A.description: the stack current set point of the hold (I.S.set)

direction.name: direction
direction.description: descending or ascending: the sign of the change from the previous set point; first for the opening hold

hold_dwell_s.name: hold_dwell_s
hold_dwell_s.description: duration of the contiguous I.S.set segment (the hold); segments under 30 s are ramp steps and are not released (their count per file is in counts.json zsw_holds)

n_samples_last_30s.name: n_samples_last_30s
n_samples_last_30s.description: samples in the last 30 s of the hold, over which the means are taken

current_density_A_cm2.name: current_density_A_cm2
current_density_A_cm2.description: mean over the last 30 s of the hold

cell_voltage_V.name: cell_voltage_V
cell_voltage_V.description: mean over the last 30 s of the hold

voltage_spread_last_30s_V.name: voltage_spread_last_30s_V
voltage_spread_last_30s_V.description: max minus min cell voltage over the last 30 s

voltage_deviation_last_120s_V.name: voltage_deviation_last_120s_V
voltage_deviation_last_120s_V.description: largest absolute deviation of the cell voltage from its mean over the last 120 s of the hold (the hold itself where shorter), rounded to 0.1 mV; the flag is computed from this rounded value

stable_pm5mV_over_last_120s.name: stable_pm5mV_over_last_120s
stable_pm5mV_over_last_120s.description: True when voltage_deviation_last_120s_V is 5 mV or less: the JRC Appendix E criterion (+/-5 mV within 2 min) as computed here

event_note.name: event_note
event_note.description: a start-up event the custodian's file name records for this checkpoint; null otherwise

temperature_C.name: temperature_C
temperature_C.description: coolant inlet T.Si.CL, mean over the last 30 s

anode_inlet_temperature_C.name: anode_inlet_temperature_C
anode_inlet_temperature_C.description: T.Si.A, mean over the last 30 s

anode_outlet_temperature_C.name: anode_outlet_temperature_C
anode_outlet_temperature_C.description: T.So.A, mean over the last 30 s

cathode_inlet_temperature_C.name: cathode_inlet_temperature_C
cathode_inlet_temperature_C.description: T.Si.C, mean over the last 30 s

cathode_outlet_temperature_C.name: cathode_outlet_temperature_C
cathode_outlet_temperature_C.description: T.So.C, mean over the last 30 s

coolant_outlet_temperature_C.name: coolant_outlet_temperature_C
coolant_outlet_temperature_C.description: T.So.CL, mean over the last 30 s (temperature_C is the coolant INLET T.Si.CL)

pressure_anode_outlet_kPa.name: pressure_anode_outlet_kPa
pressure_anode_outlet_kPa.description: p.So.A, mean over the last 30 s

pressure_cathode_outlet_kPa.name: pressure_cathode_outlet_kPa
pressure_cathode_outlet_kPa.description: p.So.C, mean over the last 30 s

flow_h2_anode_nl_min.name: flow_h2_anode_nl_min
flow_h2_anode_nl_min.description: F.Si.H.A, mean over the last 30 s

flow_air_cathode_nl_min.name: flow_air_cathode_nl_min
flow_air_cathode_nl_min.description: F.Si.Air.C, mean over the last 30 s

flow_coolant_l_min.name: flow_coolant_l_min
flow_coolant_l_min.description: F.Si.CL, mean over the last 30 s

custodian_OpHrs_h.name: custodian_OpHrs_h
custodian_OpHrs_h.description: the custodian's operating-hours counter OpHrs at the hold; ageing_hours is the file-name label

custodian_OpHrs2_h.name: custodian_OpHrs2_h
custodian_OpHrs2_h.description: the custodian's second counter OpHrs2 at the hold
